observations_used: No round-1 or round-2 proposal improved the previously observed global Pareto frontier.
(12,4), (13,3), (14,2), and (16,) remain the observed global area/WNS frontier.
(10,2,4) reached area 335.958 and WNS 7.51404 but was dominated by (13,3).
(10,3,3) reached area 338.884 and WNS 7.51622 but was dominated by (13,3).
(11,2,3) reached area 332.766 but WNS fell to 7.47937.
The evidence favors retaining a large first block and avoiding heavily segmented prefixes.
hypothesis: A three-block structure may still be competitive if the first block remains large and the added middle block is small enough that the extra carry-select stage has limited cost.
